name: GPU Isosurface Extraction from Molecular Orbital Densities
definition: An optimized GPU-based pipeline for extracting isosurfaces from molecular orbital densities (GTOs) without blocking the host, using an octree for culling, shared corner computation, and Newton projection.
summary: GPU Isosurface Extraction from Molecular Orbital Densities is a gridless method that generates triangle meshes directly from atom-centered basis functions using an octree and Newton projection, avoiding uniform voxel grids.
